mergePolicy: For each map, remove existing mechanism.layers entries whose id is listed in replaceLayerIds, then append layers in their declared order. Reject any remaining duplicate id or duplicate screen-fixed/city-parallax role. Do not change the base background URL or transform these root-stage coordinates with world geometry conversion.
resourceState: Native sources and consumers under construction; all referenced canonical SWFs require fresh compile before playable acceptance.

placementContract.screen-fixed: Root-stage fixed x/y with original source width/height; no worldScale conversion and no SpeedRate=0.
placementContract.city-parallax: A02 steady original enterFrame placement: x = gameworld._x / 2 + layer.x; y = gameworld._y + layer.y. The independent city SWF has viewBox top 109 normalized to zero, so layer.y adds it exactly once. Initial source placement (-0.75,108) is superseded before reveal by this steady camera pose.
placementContract.parent: Owned child of the existing _root.天空盒 back-plane; compensate its translation and scale without changing the shared parent's camera state. Sky depth 0, city depth 1 inside the owned holder.
